# Poppa's Wooden Creations

> Handcrafted wooden toys and kitchenware made from native New Zealand timbers (Kauri, Rimu, Macrocarpa) in Tikipunga, Whangarei, New Zealand. Trusted by Montessori schools nationwide since 2015.

Poppa's Wooden Creations is a sole-trader toy manufacturer and woodworker, operated by Adrian Barber from a workshop in Tikipunga, Whangarei. Every product is handmade in-house — not imported or dropshipped. Products are finished with non-toxic, food-safe oils and made from native NZ timbers. The business ships nationwide within New Zealand and internationally.

## Key Facts
- Materials: Native New Zealand timbers — Kauri, Rimu, Macrocarpa, Rewa Rewa, Totara
- Location: 102 Kiripaka Road, Tikipunga, Whangarei 0112, New Zealand
- Founded: 2015
- Contact: poppas.wooden.creations@gmail.com | +64 21 022 88166
- Shipping: Nationwide within New Zealand and internationally
- Trusted by Montessori schools across New Zealand
